medvita-blue.note: tokens.brand_color in theme.json; step 600 of the core-generated --color-cobalt-* scale, which the tonalRamp shows.

headline.purpose: The page h1, one per page; 1.5rem / 32px on phones, 1.75rem / 36px from 640 px.

title-sm.purpose: h3 and the weekday heads of the week grid.

figure.purpose: The value of a stat tile, in tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Running text; form fields are 16 px on phones and 14 px from 640 px.

body-sm.purpose: Tables, metadata values, buttons and navigation links (buttons and links at 500).

section.purpose: The core's section heading in ink, one step above a field label.

label.purpose: Sentence-case labels in secondary grey: table heads, metadata terms, stat labels, the location line, rail headings.

caption.purpose: Pills, markers, counters, small buttons, cell second lines.

mono.purpose: UUIDs, codes and seal digests in the system monospace.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Cards, tables and stat tiles, as compiled in the core; invisible in dark mode.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Buttons and inputs, as compiled in the core.

shadows.name: field-focus

motion.purpose: Hover and focus transitions on buttons, links and fields.

breakpoints.purpose: Container width; header search box inline.

extensions.themeBoundary: The Medvita theme (med_patients/themes/medvita) changes only tokens, fonts, logo and CSS over the core's stable component classes; layout and components belong to the apps' templates and to the core.
extensions.darkMode: The same token names redefined under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark); the core rewrites that query for a forced scheme.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a page header or form, in the Medvita blue.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-base, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / .06); transition: background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #1273c4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand, #1273c4); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-strong, #0f5ea1); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral, navigational or reversible actions such as Registrar chegada or Editar.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font: 500 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-base, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / .06); transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #1273c4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-neutral-primary-soft, #ffffff); border-color: var(--color-default-medium, #7c8ba1); color: var(--color-heading, #0f172a); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-neutral-tertiary-soft, #f8fafc); border-color: var(--color-default-strong, #475569); }

components.name: Destructive Buttons
components.description: Danger outline opens a destructive action; the red fill is only the final submit on the confirmation page.
components.html: Remover
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: 500 12px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-base, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #1273c4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger-outline { background: var(--color-neutral-primary-soft, #ffffff); border-color: var(--color-danger-subtle, #fca5a5); color: var(--color-fg-danger, #b91c1c); } .ds-btn-danger-outline:hover { background: var(--color-danger-soft, #fee2e2); } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--color-danger, #dc2626); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-danger-strong, #b91c1c); }

components.name: State Pills
components.description: A state that changes with time: round pill with a dot, soft fill, dark text; one sense per tone.
components.html: Confirmada Em atendimento Aguardando Faltou Cancelada
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-done { background: var(--color-success-soft, #dcfce7); border-color: var(--color-success-subtle, #86efac); color: var(--color-fg-success-strong, #14532d); } .ds-progress { background: var(--color-brand-softer, #f3f8fc); border-color: var(--color-brand-subtle, #c6ddf1); color: var(--color-fg-brand-strong, #0c4c81); } .ds-attention { background: var(--color-warning-soft, #fef3c7); border-color: var(--color-warning-subtle, #fcd34d); color: var(--color-fg-warning, #92400e); } .ds-failed { background: var(--color-danger-soft, #fee2e2); border-color: var(--color-danger-subtle, #fca5a5); color: var(--color-fg-danger-strong, #991b1b); } .ds-inactive { background: var(--color-neutral-secondary-soft, #f8fafc); border-color: var(--color-default, #e2e8f0); color: var(--color-body, #0f172a); }

components.name: Marker
components.description: A fixed property that changes behaviour: square-cornered label, no dot.
components.css: .ds-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-default, #e2e8f0); background: var(--color-neutral-secondary-soft, #f8fafc); color: var(--color-body, #0f172a); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 500 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-marker-warning { background: var(--color-warning-soft, #fef3c7); border-color: var(--color-warning-subtle, #fcd34d); color: var(--color-fg-warning, #92400e); } .ds-marker-brand { background: var(--color-brand-softer, #f3f8fc); border-color: var(--color-brand-subtle, #c6ddf1); color: var(--color-fg-brand-strong, #0c4c81); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White card on the slate ground, 12 px corners, a line instead of a shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-neutral-primary-soft, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-default, #e2e8f0); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 12px); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / .05), 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / .04); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--color-heading, #0f172a); } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--color-body-subtle, #5b6b82); }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-heading, #0f172a); } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--color-neutral-secondary-medium, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-default-medium, #7c8ba1); border-radius: var(--radius-base, 8px); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--color-heading, #0f172a); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / .06); transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-default-strong, #475569); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-brand, #1273c4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-brand, #1273c4) 22%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Medvita is the category standard of a practice-management suite, executed at full craft and without irony: white cards on a cool slate ground, ink-dark text, one family, thin lines, and the Medvita logo blue only on what can be clicked. Nothing on a screen asks to be decoded. The receptionist sees who is here, with whom, since when and what to do next; the doctor sees the chart and what is permanent. The finish level is set by Linear (density, alignment, keyboard), Stripe Dashboard (tables, states, money) and Nubank (plain Brazilian language and trust); none of them is a look to copy.

The system is dense but calm. Colour carries meaning, never mood: five state tones with one sense each, the brand blue for action, eight appointment-type colours that always travel with the type written beside them. Depth comes from borders; shadows are hairline at most and real only on what floats. Light and dark are the same system with the same token names, dark in slate night. Paper is a first-class output: certificates, prescriptions, encounter copies and receipts print whole, without the app shell.

What this is and is not allowed to be: the Medvita theme (`med_patients/themes/medvita/`) can change only tokens, fonts, logo and CSS over the core's stable component classes (`.card`, `.btn*`, `.badge*`, `.table-scroll`, `.table-stack`, `.page-header`, `.sidebar*`, `.message`, and the rest listed in the core's `docs/ui-design.md`). Layout, screen structure and components belong to the apps' templates and to the Skeleton core. If a screen needs a new arrangement, that is template work in an app, never a theme rule. The direction rejects the decorated medical-SaaS look: gradients, teal washes, stock illustrations, dashboards of vanity numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Slate neutrals, ink text, white cards on a #f8fafc ground; slate night in dark mode.
The Medvita blue (#1273c4) on primary buttons, links, focus, active navigation, selected options, counters and the in-progress pill, and nowhere else.
States as soft tinted pills with a dot and dark text; markers as square-cornered labels without a dot.
One family, IBM Plex Sans (the core's), headings 600, sentence-case labels, tabular numerals.
8 px controls, 12 px cards, round pills; borders over shadows.
Every list stacks into cards on a phone; every document prints whole.

rules.name: The Blue Means Act Rule
rules.body: The Medvita blue appears only on primary buttons, links, focus rings, the active navigation item and tab, selected options, counters and the in-progress state. Headings, icons at rest, location lines, illustrations and backgrounds are never blue.

rules.name: The One Sense Per Tone Rule
rules.body: Green is done, blue is in progress, amber asks for the person, red failed or cannot be undone, slate is inactive. A failure is always red; nothing else is.

rules.name: The Clinic Wins Rule
rules.body: The theme never declares a brand token. The blue comes from `brand_color`, so a practice with its own colour replaces it everywhere at once.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Everything is IBM Plex Sans; hierarchy comes from 400 / 500 / 600 and size. No heading face, no font file in the theme (the test refuses Inter, Poppins and a display token).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are written as they are spoken, first letter capital. The theme takes the core's uppercase and wide tracking off every label it styles that way, and no app stylesheet sets uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, table cells, metadata values, stat values, queue numbers, time slots and amounts use tabular numerals, so columns of hours and reais line up. Amounts are also right-aligned and never wrap.

rules.name: The No Sideways Page Rule
rules.body: A page never scrolls horizontally on a phone: lists stack, and only a declared dense table scrolls inside its card.

rules.name: The Whole Document Rule
rules.body: Print hides the shell and the navigation by class, never a bare `header`, `footer`, `nav`, `main`, `article` or `section`, so a certificate or receipt keeps its own header and footer.

rules.name: The Borders Over Shadows Rule
rules.body: A container is separated by its line and its fill. A shadow larger than a hairline means the thing floats above the page; a card never does.

dos: **Do** show every state through the app's tone filter and the core's `status_badge` (`{{ code|scheduling_state:"status"|status_badge:label }}`), and every fixed property through `marker`.
**Do** keep the Medvita blue for primary buttons, links, focus, active navigation and tabs, selected options, counters and the in-progress state.
**Do** give each region at most one `btn-primary`; open a destructive action with `btn-danger-outline` and finish it with `btn-danger` on the confirmation page.
**Do** wrap every list in `table-scroll table-stack` with a `data-label` on every cell; declare a scroll-only table with `{# table-scroll only: reason #}`.
**Do** write dates and times with `|moment`, money with `|brl` in the `amount` class, and numbers in tabular figures.
**Do** write labels in sentence case at 13 / 18 px.
**Do** colour app CSS only with tokens (`var(--color-*)`, `var(--mv-type-*)` with a core fallback); a hex value in an app stylesheet fails `tests/test_ui_conventions.py`.
**Do** write the appointment type beside its colour swatch, and the label beside every pill.
**Do** give frequent actions a 44 px target.
**Do** hide shell and navigation in print by class and keep a document's own header, footer and signature block.
**Do** change the look through the theme's tokens, logo and CSS over the core's component classes; change layout or components in the app's templates.
donts: **Don't** hand-write a `badge`, `alert`, `empty-state` or `error-summary` in a template; use the core component.
**Don't** label a destructive verb (Remover, Revogar, Excluir, Desativar, Descartar, Anular, Estornar, Encerrar, Cancelar a/o) on a primary, secondary or ghost button.
**Don't** hide a bare `header`, `footer`, `nav`, `main`, `article` or `section` in a print rule.
**Don't** paint headings, resting icons, the location line, backgrounds or illustrations in the brand blue.
**Don't** declare `--color-cobalt-*`, `--color-brand*`, `--color-fg-brand*` or `--color-focus` in the theme CSS; a clinic's own colour must win.
**Don't** add a second font family or a font file to the theme.
**Don't** mark an app item's type or state with a coloured side stripe; the type is a round swatch beside its written name.
**Don't** let colour carry information alone: no swatch without the type, no pill without its label.
**Don't** separate a card with a shadow larger than a hairline; real shadows are for what floats.
**Don't** use decorative gradient fills, teal or tinted washes as decoration, stock illustrations, or dashboards of vanity numbers (the edge fade of the phone tab strip is a mask, not a fill).
